question: Who is associated with Pandavani style of folk singing based on the epic Mahabharat? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (11/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Vimalakka
Teejan Bai
Sharda Sinha
Hira Devi Waiba
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Teejan Bai

Explanation:
Pandavani is a folk singing style based on the epic Mahabharata, prevalent mainly in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh. Teejan Bai is the most renowned exponent of this style and has been honored with Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan. In Pandavani, the performer narrates the story of the Pandavas through solo acting and singing. This style has two main forms: Kapalik and Vedmati. Teejan Bai performs in the Vedmati style, which involves singing without musical instruments.

question: What was 26th January called in India before 1947? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Republic Day
Martyr's Day
Constitution Day
Independence Day
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Independence Day

Explanation:
Before 1947, 26th January was celebrated as Independence Day in India. In 1929, the Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress passed the Purna Swaraj resolution, and on 26th January 1930, the first Independence Day was observed. This tradition continued annually until 1947. After India gained independence in 1947, the Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into effect on 26th January 1950, which was then declared as Republic Day. Independence Day is now celebrated on 15th August. Thus, before 1947, 26th January was called Independence Day.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ Which day was first celebrated on 26th January 1930? → Independence Day
☛ When is Republic Day celebrated in India? → 26th January
☛ When did the Constitution of India come into effect? → 26th January 1950
☛ Who moved the Purna Swaraj resolution? → Jawaharlal Nehru
question_hi: 1947 से पहले भारत में 26 जनवरी को क्या कहा जाता था? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/03/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: गणतंत्र दिवस
शहीद दिवस
संविधान दिवस
स्वतंत्रता दिवस
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है स्वतंत्रता दिवस

Explanation:
1947 से पहले 26 जनवरी को स्वतंत्रता दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता था। 1929 में लाहौर अधिवेशन में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने पूर्ण स्वराज का प्रस्ताव पारित किया और 26 जनवरी 1930 को पहली बार स्वतंत्रता दिवस मनाया गया। यह परंपरा 1947 तक जारी रही। 1947 में भारत को स्वतंत्रता मिलने के बाद 26 जनवरी 1950 को संविधान लागू हुआ और इसे गणतंत्र दिवस घोषित किया गया। स्वतंत्रता दिवस अब 15 अगस्त को मनाया जाता है। इस प्रकार, 1947 से पूर्व 26 जनवरी स्वतंत्रता दिवस था।

question: When did Bangladesh emerge as an independent country? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1971
1972
1970
1975
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1971

Explanation:
Bangladesh was part of Pakistan as East Pakistan. In 1971, the Liberation War took place between the Pakistani army and Bangladeshi freedom fighters (Mukti Bahini). After India's intervention, Pakistan surrendered on 16 December 1971, leading to the birth of Bangladesh. Bangladesh emerged as a secular democracy and Sheikh Mujibur Rahman became its first Prime Minister. Bangladesh gained membership in the United Nations in 1974.

question: WTO is a world organisation. Which of the following statements about WTO is INCORRECT? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala of Nigeria is the organisation's seventh Director-General.
Its top decision-making body is the Ministerial Conference.
Its full form is World Transport Organisation.
It deals with the rules of trade between nations.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Its full form is World Transport Organisation.

Explanation:
The full form of WTO is World Trade Organisation, not World Transport Organisation. WTO was established in 1995 following the Uruguay Round negotiations. Its headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland. It sets the rules of trade between member nations and helps resolve disputes. The top decision-making body is the Ministerial Conference, which meets every two years. The current Director-General is Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala of Nigeria, who is the first woman and first African to hold this position.

☛ Where is WTO headquarters? → Geneva, Switzerland

☛ What is the full form of WTO? → World Trade Organisation
question_hi: WTO एक विश्व संगठन है। WTO के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन गलत है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 1)

Explanation:
WTO का पूरा नाम विश्व व्यापार संगठन (World Trade Organisation) है, न कि विश्व परिवहन संगठन। WTO का गठन 1995 में उरुग्वे दौर की वार्ता के परिणामस्वरूप हुआ था। इसका मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में स्थित है। यह सदस्य देशों के बीच व्यापार के नियमों को निर्धारित करता है और विवाद समाधान में सहायता करता है। शीर्ष निर्णय लेने वाली संस्था मंत्रिस्तरीय सम्मेलन है, जो हर दो वर्ष में आयोजित होता है। वर्तमान महानिदेशक नगोजी ओकोन्जो-इवेला (नाइजीरिया) हैं, जो संगठन की पहली महिला और अफ्रीकी महानिदेशक हैं।

question: Which of the following statements about the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is INCORRECT?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: An aim of the Association is to accelerate economic growth, social progress and cultural development in the region.
ASEAN was established on 8 August 1967 in Bangkok.
It comprises a group of ten member states as of 2019.
It started with three original member countries.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It started with three original member countries.

Explanation:
ASEAN was established on 8 August 1967 in Bangkok through the ASEAN Declaration (Bangkok Declaration). The founding members were five countries: Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand. Later, Brunei (1984), Vietnam (1995), Laos and Myanmar (1997), and Cambodia (1999) joined, making a total of ten member states. The aim of ASEAN is to accelerate economic growth, social progress, and cultural development in the region. Therefore, the statement that it started with three original member countries is incorrect.

☛ Establishment place → Bangkok, Thailand
☛ Founding document → ASEAN Declaration (Bangkok Declaration)

☛ Current member count → Ten

question: In which of the following cities is the Mahakaleshwar temple situated? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: Bhopal
Bhubaneswar
Ujjain
Varanasi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ujjain

Explanation:
The Mahakaleshwar temple is located in the city of Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh. It is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. The temple is renowned for its unique south-facing (dakshinamukhi) tradition, which distinguishes it from other Shiva temples. The present structure was built in the 18th century by the Maratha rulers. Ujjain was known as Ujjayini in ancient times and was the capital of King Vikramaditya. The temple is situated on the banks of the Kshipra River and is considered highly sacred in Hinduism. On the occasion of Mahashivaratri, special prayers and fairs are held here.

question: Which of the following is NOT involved in organising the Global Bio India - 2021 event? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (26/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Department of Biotechnology
Ministry of Science and Technology
solution:

Explanation:
Global Bio India - 2021 was a major biotechnology event organized by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science and Technology, and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC). It aimed to position India as a global leader in biotechnology. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare was not involved in organizing this event as it primarily deals with healthcare services, policy-making, and disease control, rather than industry-focused biotechnology events. The event focused on promoting innovation, startups, and collaboration in the biotechnology sector.

question: When was Mangalyaan, which was launched by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO), successfully placed into the orbit of Mars? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (26/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: 24 September 2014
5 November 2013
24 November 2014
5 September 2013
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 24 September 2014

Explanation:
Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) was launched by ISRO on 5 November 2013. It was India's first interplanetary mission, which successfully entered Mars' orbit on 24 September 2014. With this, India became the first Asian country and the fourth in the world (after the US, Russia, and the European Space Agency) to place a spacecraft in Mars orbit. The mission is known for its cost-effectiveness, with a total cost of about ₹450 crore. Mangalyaan sent back images of the Martian surface and studied the presence of methane gas. It was originally designed for 90 days but operated for several years.

question: Which Indian state was in ancient history known as Kamarupa? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/03/2021) Shift 2)

Assam
Odisha
solution:

Explanation:
In ancient India, Kamarupa was a prominent kingdom located in the present-day region of Assam. It was a powerful empire in eastern India with its capital at Pragjyotishpur (modern Guwahati). question: IAQ means - (RRB JE CE (28/08/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Interior Architectural Quality
Interior Airconditioning Quality
Indoor Air Quality
Indoor Air Quantity
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Indoor Air Quality

Explanation:
IAQ stands for Indoor Air Quality, which refers to the air quality within and around buildings and structures, especially as it relates to the health and comfort of occupants. Poor IAQ can lead to respiratory issues, allergies, and fatigue. Maintaining good IAQ involves controlling pollutants, ventilation, and air filtration. Key parameters measured include CO2, PM2.5, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). IAQ is a critical aspect of environmental science and building management, with standards set by organizations like WHO and ASHRAE. Ensuring proper ventilation and reducing indoor pollutants are essential for healthy indoor environments.

question: When did Lord Clive finally return to England from India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/01/2021) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following is a feature of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003 (FRBMA)? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (02/12/2024) Shift 1)

The reduction in fiscal deficit by 0.3 per cent of GDP each year
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The reduction in fiscal deficit by 0.3 per cent of GDP each year

Explanation:
The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act (FRBMA), 2003 aims to establish fiscal discipline in India. Under this act, the government was required to reduce the fiscal deficit by 0.3 per cent of GDP each year. This provision was a key feature to ensure gradual reduction of the deficit to sustainable levels. The act mandates the central government to bring down the fiscal deficit to 3% of GDP by 2008-09, with annual reductions of 0.3% of GDP. It promotes fiscal responsibility and long-term financial stability. Although later amendments changed some targets, the original annual reduction rate remained a core feature.
